title: AgentMemoryPolicy
description: The memory-governance contract for an agent run on the shared plane. scope bounds what the run may read/write: tenant (this tenant's memory only), run (ephemeral, this run only), or none (no memory access). cross_tenant is pinned const false — an agent run can NEVER read or write across tenants; tenant-private lineage never becomes global. writes_allowed gates whether the run may persist memory at all (deny-by-default: false unless explicitly enabled). Anything an agent writes to memory is a candidate proposal, not vouched truth.

scope.description: memory visibility bound: tenant = this tenant only; run = ephemeral to this run; none = no memory access

cross_tenant.description: ALWAYS false — cross-tenant memory access is forbidden; tenant-private lineage never becomes global

writes_allowed.description: when false (default), the run may not persist memory; when true, writes are scoped by `scope` and remain candidate proposals
